 Paris Saint-Germain vs Bayern Munich: kick-off time
 Women's Champions League - Game Week 4 10 Nov 2026 - 14:00 Parc des Princes Paris Saint-Germain and Bayern Munich meet in the Women's Champions League at the Stade Sébastien Charléty in Paris. Both are fighting for points in their bid to progress from the league phase.
 Under coach Paulo César, PSG sit sixth in the table. The Paris side have been inconsistent: they won 4-0 against Le Havre last time out, but lost 4-0 to Olympique Lyon in their previous match.
 Bayern Munich arrive in Paris on the back of a 3-1 Bundesliga win over Werder Bremen. José Barcala's side sit seventh in the Women's Champions League.
 With both sides looking to make up ground in the group phase, Bayern have had the upper hand in recent meetings. PSG will be looking to reverse that trend.
 Watch the match live: the TV and streaming details are below.
 Talking points of the week: what has been happening at Paris Saint-Germain and Bayern Munich?
 PSG have taken two wins, two draws and one defeat from their last five games. Their 4-0 defeat to Olympique Lyon was the only loss in that stretch, while they most recently drew 1-1 with Manchester City in the Women's Champions League. PSG scored seven goals and conceded six across those five games.
 Bayern Munich have won four and drawn one of their last five games. Their most recent Bundesliga match ended in a 3-1 win over Werder Bremen, while they also beat VfB Stuttgart 5-0. Bayern most recently drew 2-2 with Real Madrid Femenino in the Women's Champions League. They scored twelve goals and conceded four in that five-game spell.
